The dataset isn't present in the working directory. Let me search the broader filesystem.

```python
import os, glob

search_roots = ["/tmp", os.path.expanduser("~"), "/mnt", "/data", "/workspace", "/content", "/home", "/opt"]
hits = []
for root in search_roots:
    if os.path.isdir(root):
        for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*titanic*"), recursive=True):
            hits.append(p)

print("Titanic-related paths:", sorted(set(hits))[:50])

print("\nAny CSV files (limited scan):")
csvs = []
for root in search_roots:
    if os.path.isdir(root):
        csvs += glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*.csv"), recursive=True)
print(sorted(set(csvs))[:50])

print("\nContents of CWD (/tmp):", sorted(os.listdir("/tmp"))[:50])
```
